title: Ruleset: randomizer
description: rules/<id>/randomizer.yaml: what a randomized run may change (packages/game/randomizer, docs/modules/game/randomizer.md). A run changes only what its settings turn on.

enemies.description: The map NPC slots of the plain wild enemies, by map id: only these take another species. Every other NPC (bosses, story fights, recruits, characters) keeps its own.

kept_items.description: Items that keep every place they are found in and never appear anywhere else (key items and the items the story checks in the bag), ids of data/items.

excluded_items.description: Items the randomizer never places or drops, ids of data/items.

excluded_species.description: Species no pick gives (evolution, starter, wild enemy), ids of data/digimon.
